parsed.note_claim: Sony dropped the game first before any Xbox selection by Kojima.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: "As confirmed earlier through our official channels, in mid-June of this year, we unexpectedly received notice from PlayStation Studios that they would cancel the Physint project," says Kojima in a tweet.
parsed.reason: The page quotes Kojima confirming PlayStation cancelled the project first, after which he sought and chose Xbox as a new partner.
